Such a perfect person, the only pity was having a disabled husband.
Everyone advised her to kick him out and find someone better.
But a few days later, they saw the man who had been in a wheelchair stand up and become the rich and powerful ruler of the Huo Family.
He then pinned Nan Yu in a corner, held her by the waist, and with a hint of red in his eyes, and said, “Sweetie, I heard that you want to divorce me?”
Remembering his wildness in bed, Nan Yu shook her head violently, “No! Those are all rumors. You are the only one I want to spend my life with!”
the-forsaken-hero:
I closed my eyes and let out a long, shuddering breath. The needle slipped through my numb fingers and clattered onto the rough pavement. Nothingness swirled around me, bringing the first peace I'd felt in my short, miserable life. No one would miss me, and if any did...? Well, there was always someone else to beat or rape. They'd move on quickly.
But then...gods? Since when did nothingness have so many gods?
Chosen by the goddess of Fate, I'm thrust into a world of magic and wonder alongside nine other heroes. A world where the gods reign supreme, and evil is vanquished before it can spread its blight.
Can such a place truly exist? Could life really be worth living?
I've heard that the brightest lights cast the longest shadows, but my life has been nothing but darkness. Perhaps this new world will be the chance I need to find the light, to see the other side.
the-mafia-lord-forgotten-bride:
Five years ago, June Trevor was forced to become the wife of Rauf Salvador, the most feared mafia lord in the city.
It was supposed to be her stepsister Amie's wedding. But when Rauf lost his sight in a terrible accident days before the wedding, Amie abandoned him, refusing to spend her life caring for a blind man.
With the Trevor family's life hanging in the balance, June was forced to take her sister's place.
What began as a marriage built on fear slowly became something June never expected. For five years, she stayed beside Rauf, caring for him through his darkest days. She became his confidante, his best friend, and eventually, the woman he loved.
Then, just one day before Rauf's surgery to restore his sight, June discovered she was pregnant.
She couldn't wait to tell him.
But when Rauf opened his eyes, the first woman he saw was Amie.
The sister who had abandoned him five years ago returned and claimed to be his wife.
And Rauf believed her.
Overnight, June went from being the woman who had sacrificed five years for him to a stranger no one wanted to acknowledge. Even her family turned against her, leaving her with nothing but the child growing inside her.…
the-mirror-master: In the 800th year of the Wu Dynasty, Lu Bai is 'resurrected' from a pile of white bones with an Ancient Mirror embedded in his chest. He steps into his courtyard, only to find his family nearly wiped out in a treacherous, unpredictable world teeming with evil spirits.
the-silly-alchemist:
My past life: Ordinary. Mediocre.
What I want in this life: Riches. Power. Influence.
My goal: To be a prodigal son. A waste youth with riches and power. Maybe even sidekicks.
My name is Ye Lang, I’m an alchemist, and I’m also here to squander as much money as I can.
the-story-of-living-as-i-please-after-be: Hit by a truck as a young man, after winning God’s ultimate lottery prize, I got to create a HOLY sh*t-like cheat ability of my choosing, create a harem, make loads of money, sleep with a random babe, and do anything I liked; it’s that kind of story.
the-support-ate-it-all:
The “S-rank Hero Factory” that raised 1,000 S-rank heroes.
The graduates’ manufacturing machine.
The strongest support.
These are all words that refer to me. But could this actually be the world of that game?
urban-invincible-overlord:
Yang Fei, who dominated the Underworld overseas, followed his master's arrangements and returned to China for a blind date marriage. He expected to be despised, but instead, he was spoiled by his wife to the heavens.
Just married, the two young people, who had never been in a relationship before, strived to coexist harmoniously, being honest with each other and trying to understand and accept one another.
Several months into the marriage.
Yang Fei: “I suspect my wife has another identity.”
Qin Yanyang: “Do a thorough investigation for me. My husband is definitely not that simple.”
victor-of-tucson:
Victor can’t wait to get the hell out of high school, go to the local community college on a sports scholarship, and start his own life. But that’s all put on hold when he enters his abuela’s house and somehow ends up stepping into a world unlike anything he’s ever known, filled with fantastical meta-humans; walking, talking devils; and other creatures one usually needs some serious pharmaceuticals to see.
Fanwath is no dream, though. In fact, it’s a nightmare. Sold into slavery as a pit fighter, Victor quickly learns his new home is controlled by the “System,” and the only way to get ahead is to fight, kill, and collect the precious “Energy,” which means the difference between a long life and an early grave. And according to his stats, Victor’s starting out at a solid zero.
Lucky for him, no one in this world has ever met his kind before—which means they have no idea what he’s really capable of. But they’re about to find out . . .
Release Schedule: 3k+ word chapters every Sunday, Tuesday, and Thursday.
villains-pov-the-heroines-want-me:
Ethan was a jobless shut-in who spent his days in his apartement, eating fast food, playing games, and reading novels. His favorite book to read was 'Magus Of The Reverse World', a popular fantasy novel about a protagonist's journey from obscurity to the peak of power in the world. He loved reading it daily, and so did many.
However, that all changed when his favorite character, Rize, was killed. He was one of the main villains of the story and he was slain by the protagonist himself, something that many fans celebrated, except for him.
“These idiots don't get it! Rize was always right! If I were in his place, I would've done the same exact thing!”
As if fate heard his bold claim, Ethan lost consciousness and woke up in a completely different world as none other than Rize himself. With the knowledge from the book he read and with his rather peculiar intuitions... Rize's journey began again.
This time, he wanted to change things and get the good ending he deserved. In a mythical, vast world, where enemies lurked in every corner... And the Heroines who seemed to be chasing him around for some reason.
“What the hell do you want from me?!”
“Mmmm, Rize~ You smell so sweet...”
wizard-starting-from-the-skill-tree:
Duke wakes up one day to find himself in an era belonging to Wizards, accompanied by a Skill Tree.
Skills possessed will become the branches of the tree, and by grinding proficiency, leaves can gradually grow, flowers blossom, and fruits ripen.
Pluck the fruit of truth, use infinite knowledge as a fulcrum, and leverage the Endless Plane, I am eternity!
[Scythe: Level 2 (0/1300)]
At the same time, on the branch of the Skill Tree, that small green bud grew into a tender green leaf.
[Scythe Skill Level Up, Gain 0.1 Free Attribute Points]
